# Deskio (桌面美颜) — full product reference

Source: https://github.com/kagangungor/deskio
License: MIT (https://github.com/kagangungor/deskio/blob/main/LICENSE)
Publisher: kagangungor (https://github.com/kagangungor)
Last reviewed: __LAST_REVIEWED__

## What it is

Deskio is a free, open-source Windows desktop beautifier built with Tauri 2 and Rust
(React UI in the system WebView2). It restyles every desktop icon with one of nine
hand-tuned looks, draws translucent organizer zones onto the wallpaper, and can swap or
remove the shortcut-arrow overlay. Before any change it snapshots the desktop (icons,
shortcut arrows, wallpaper), so one click restores the exact original state. It runs
entirely on the user's machine: no account, no telemetry, no uploads.

Deskio（桌面美颜）是一款免费开源的 Windows 桌面美化工具，基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust。
它用九套手工调校的外观给桌面图标换装，在壁纸上圈出半透明的整理分区，还能替换或去掉快捷
方式小箭头。所有改动之前都会先给桌面拍快照（图标、箭头、壁纸），一键即可还原到和原来
一模一样。它只在本机运行：没有账号，没有遥测，什么都不上传。
发布状态：__AVAILABILITY_ZH__

## Requirements and availability

- Supported: 64-bit Windows 10 version 1809 or newer, and Windows 11.
- Not available for macOS or Linux.
__AVAILABILITY_EN__
- Price: free forever. Open source under the MIT license.

## Features

- Nine built-in icon looks, applied to every icon in one click. English names:
  Squircle, Blueprint, Pixel Era, Gleam, Glaze, Die-Cut, Porthole, Scrapbook, Creekstone.
  中文名：方圆、蓝图、像素纪元、浮光、釉光、随形贴、圆窗、拼贴手帐、溪石。
- Full customization beyond the presets: eleven icon shapes, plus coloring, plates,
  finishes, and shortcut marks, each adjustable independently; apps, folders, and plain
  files can each wear their own style; per-icon restyle via right-click; undo/redo.
- Style library: save your own combinations, export them as files, import style packs.
- Wallpaper zones: translucent organizer regions drawn onto the wallpaper with five
  materials and four title styles; ready-made layout templates apply in one click; the
  original wallpaper is backed up and zones remove in one click.
- Shortcut arrow: swap the default overlay for a cleaner mark or remove it entirely
  (a whitelisted elevated helper changes one Shell Icons registry value, snapshotted
  first and restorable like everything else).
- Calm helper: optionally quiets some of Windows' noisier defaults; asks before every
  change and every change can be turned back.
- Reversibility as an architectural constraint: every write goes through a snapshot and
  transaction ledger; one-click restore returns the desktop to its exact prior state.
- Live preview: what you see in the app is rendered by the same Rust icon core that
  bakes the final icons (WASM in preview, native on apply).

## FAQ (English)

Q: Can Deskio break my PC, or leave me stuck?
A: No. Deskio snapshots the Windows desktop (icons, shortcut arrows, wallpaper)
   before changing anything, and every change is one click to undo, back to exactly how
   it was.

Q: Will Deskio slow my computer down?
A: Not noticeably. Deskio does the heavy work once on apply; the rest of the time
   it sits quietly and puts the look back if Windows resets the desktop.

Q: Is Deskio really free?
A: Deskio is free and MIT-licensed, with the source on GitHub. It runs only on the
   user's machine: no account, no telemetry, nothing uploaded.

Q: Does Deskio work on macOS or Linux?
A: No. Deskio is built for 64-bit Windows 10 (version 1809 or newer) and
   Windows 11 only.

## FAQ（中文）

问：Deskio 会不会把电脑搞坏，或者回不去了？
答：不会。Deskio（桌面美颜）动手之前先给 Windows 桌面拍快照，图标、快捷方式箭头、
    壁纸都在内，每处改动都能一键还原到和原来一模一样。

问：Deskio 会拖慢电脑吗？
答：感觉不到。重活只在点应用的那一下发生，其余时间它安静待着，Windows 重置桌面时再帮
    你把外观补回来。

问：Deskio 真的免费吗？
答：完全免费，MIT 许可证，源码就在 GitHub。它只在本机运行：没有账号，没有遥测，什么
    都不上传。

问：macOS 或 Linux 能用 Deskio 吗？
答：不能。Deskio 只面向 64 位 Windows 10（1809 及以上）和 Windows 11。

## Privacy

Deskio runs entirely locally. It requires no account, collects no telemetry, and
uploads nothing. The only elevated operation is the optional shortcut-arrow registry
change, performed by a small whitelisted helper and snapshotted before it runs.
